entries.note: Opt-in Node bridge reads the active environment in process.
Mutation applies to the current run; it is not persisted to the environment file.
Unset and clear are returned as explicit session changes; replaceIn uses visible scopes.
Opt-in Node bridge reads collection variables.
Collection mutations are session-scoped and carried back through the Rust contract.
Global mutations are session-scoped and are not persisted to a global file.
Runner iteration data is read-only and participates in visible variable precedence.
Runtime session mutations and request header changes are supported; broader scope semantics remain limited.

Postman-shaped URL protocol/host/port/path/hash metadata, read-only path variables, method, headers, cookies, auth and raw/JSON/form body facades are supported; broader URL object parity remains limited.
Request headers, cookies and URL query lists expose bounded get/has/all/count/each/toObject plus add/upsert/remove/clear where mutation is meaningful.
Type, parameter get/has/upsert/remove/clear and reconstruction for no-auth, Basic, Bearer, API key and common OAuth parameters are supported.

Status, timing, raw text/body, JSON, header/cookie access, body and cookie assertions, status categories, positive and negated header value matching, jsonBody path checks and header/cookie toObject helpers are exposed.
Assertions are collected and affect runner/send exit status when scripts are enabled.

Equality and equals aliases, stable deep equality, primitive/array/object inclusion, array members and include.members, direct and nested properties with that/is chaining, exact/all/any keys, length, oneOf, empty, null/undefined/exist, numeric comparisons, type, boolean and regex checks are implemented.

Opt-in callback requests support bounded HTTP(S) subrequests, URL query parameters, headers, Bearer/Basic/API-key auth, raw/urlencoded/form-data/GraphQL bodies, response text/JSON and response assertions; file bodies plus proxy/TLS parity and broader request options remain limited.
Logs are captured locally but not printed by the CLI to avoid accidental secret disclosure.
